candidate_practices.name: Map each design change to a diagnosed failure
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect particular mechanisms to identified failures instead of presenting components only as a feature list.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this lets readers assess why a component belongs in the proposed solution.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a component inventory with failure → proposed intervention pairs; distinguish a motivating diagnosis from a demonstrated mechanism.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent independent component roles when the method works through inseparable interactions.

support.specific_example: Repeated incorrect answers motivate separating recognition from relational reasoning; small-sample stability motivates the vMF metric.
Span aggregation addresses multi-token computation, while recursive tracing addresses attribution absorbed by intermediate reasoning.
Recoverable static signatures motivate input-conditioned signatures intended to prevent cross-input transfer.
A geometric account of additive-update interference motivates multiplicative orthogonal editing and preservation claims.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether diagnoses are established, components isolate the stated failures, and security or geometric claims hold under the evaluated conditions.

candidate_practices.name: Define resources by the work they enable
candidate_practices.source_observation: Resource abstracts describe construction or interface choices alongside the evaluation, training, or programming capability they provide.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: capability-linked descriptions can establish a resource contribution without requiring algorithmic priority.
candidate_practices.application: State what becomes constructible, executable, or comparable; attach coverage and validation to that capability rather than listing artifacts alone.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not promise downstream improvements when the contribution only supplies infrastructure.

support.specific_example: Dual control changes passive users into tool-using participants; task generation and constrained simulation support testing coordination.
Metadata-to-executable-task automation supports LiveCVEBench and training environments, with expert-reproduction comparisons and reported training gains.
SoftJAX and SoftTorch consolidate fragmented relaxations into drop-in operator families and report benchmarks and a case study.

contrasts.contrast: MAP contributes first-hand deployment knowledge; its resource value does not depend on an executable pipeline.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Resource quality, maintenance, coverage definitions, interface compatibility, and whether downstream comparisons isolate resource effects.

candidate_practices.name: Challenge the proxy before choosing the evaluation target
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish a familiar signal or objective from the property the work actually concerns.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this can change what authors measure, rather than merely improving a score on an inherited proxy.
candidate_practices.application: Name the target property, explain the proxy mismatch, and specify whether the replacement is a proposed criterion, implemented measure, or tested association.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Retain the existing proxy when it directly answers the research question; normative criteria still require operationalization.

support.specific_example: DSF measures definition alignment; its reported partial correlation is +0.41, whereas three memorization proxies show no positive association.
The position advocates informed, representative, friction-robust discourse as evaluation targets instead of engagement.
The landscape argument distinguishes viewer authenticity concerns from depicted subjects' dignity harms, which detection may leave unresolved.
Facial-attribute suppression is paired with joint privacy and anomaly-detection assessment.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Metric construction, validity, stakeholder evidence, and privacy scope; position-paper recommendations do not establish intervention effectiveness.

candidate_practices.name: Separate local speed, system speed, and quality
candidate_practices.source_observation: These systems abstracts distinguish execution bottlenecks and evaluation levels, with different forms of quality qualification.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: separating levels prevents a local acceleration from silently becoming a whole-system claim.
candidate_practices.application: Identify the optimized operation and hardware condition, then report system consequences separately. Preserve qualifiers such as 'up to' and 'geometric mean' and name the quality criterion.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: For a component-only contribution, bound the claim to that component instead of inventing an end-to-end result.

support.specific_example: Activation approximations have platform-level speed claims; ConvNeXt separately supplies end-to-end gains and an accuracy qualification.
IO-aware reformulation supports fused kernels; A100 results distinguish up to 32× forward and 161× end-to-end speedups.
Sketch–kernel co-design exposes an efficiency–robustness parameter, states OSE guarantees, and reports Pareto gains plus roughly 1.7× geometric-mean speedup.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Timing boundaries, baseline configurations, hardware comparability, numerical behavior, quality matching, and aggregation procedures.

candidate_practices.name: Make capability boundaries the theoretical contribution
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish guarantees by assumptions, strategy classes, or architecture, sometimes adding counterexamples and remedies.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can identify which change permits a result and which broader claim remains unsupported.
candidate_practices.application: Write the successful domain and guarantee together; separately state the obstruction and the exact assumption, strategy, or architecture change used to address it.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not manufacture a counterexample or imply a converse when only sufficient conditions are established.

support.specific_example: Uniform-pricing nonexistence motivates richer pricing; the reported factor-2 protection specifically concerns deviations to uniform prices.
Existence under playerwise concavity is separated from potential-game computation with exact gradients, feasible initialization, and O(epsilon^-3) iterations.
A necessary implication becomes an equivalence for subgames; a three-player counterexample and leaklessness delimit broader stability claims.
Sufficient learnability conditions accompany MPNN impossibilities, richer architectures, and a Bellman–Ford-specific refinement.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact quantifiers, definitions, deviation classes, approximation notions, proof correctness, and whether proposed remedies cover all stated obstructions.

candidate_practices.name: Turn an explanatory label into a concrete account
candidate_practices.source_observation: Explanation-oriented abstracts name representations, governing factors, or temporal stages rather than stopping at a phenomenon label.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: concrete accounts suggest what evidence would distinguish the explanation from a restatement.
candidate_practices.application: After naming the phenomenon, specify its proposed representation or mechanism and an observable implication; distinguish formal scope from empirical extension.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not impose mechanistic claims on descriptive findings or present a representation as a validated explanation.

support.specific_example: Theory-building is instantiated as induced executable programs, with explanation-driven generalization reported but no tasks specified.
Cross-split consistency is linked to shared Gaussian statistics and variance factors; linear-model predictions are checked on UNet and DiT outside memorization.
Focus–dilution is unpacked into condensation, frequency-driven focus, redistribution, and restart, with named corroborating datasets.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Discriminating predictions, mechanism evidence, approximation error, and transfer beyond the formal setting.

candidate_practices.name: Show the bridge from a local construction to broader scope
candidate_practices.source_observation: Two abstracts distinguish a smaller construction from an integration or generalization step.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes a broad framework claim inspectable without treating breadth as self-evident.
candidate_practices.application: Identify the local procedure first, then state what additional algorithm or structural condition supports expansion.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not imply that combining modules automatically establishes generality.

support.specific_example: OMAC distinguishes optimization along one of five dimensions from a separate joint-optimization algorithm.
Gemma-style patches precede a multi-layer construction and input/output controllability conditions for broader applicability.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: The actual optimization dimensions, integration interactions, controllability definitions, and scope of perfect patch equivalence.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Use deployment prevalence to surface a research agenda.
unusual_but_useful.application: Pair study coverage—20 interviews and 86 surveyed practitioners across 26 domains—with reported workflow, adaptation, and evaluation patterns, then distinguish practitioner challenges from validated solutions.
unusual_but_useful.limit: The 68%, 70%, and 74% figures need denominator and sampling checks; they do not establish best practices or deployment-success causes.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs one method and a benchmark victory.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Position, resource, and theoretical contributions support different evidence structures and multiple coherent contributions.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: A named replacement metric proves the intended property.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Association, proposed normative criteria, and reported privacy filtering establish different and limited claims.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: These patterns explain Oral selection or validate ORAL.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Selected abstracts supply neither selection evidence nor comparative evidence for a writing framework.
